objective: Make every known self-repair, transport, evidence, independence, validation, wiring and closure defect an explicit fail-closed obligation. No candidate or profile revision may be represented as implementation-ready while any mandatory obligation is below READBACK_CLOSED.

progress_contract.rule: Progress is derived from evidence. A producer/reviewer may not choose an arbitrary percentage.

global_closure_rule.expression: EVERY mandatory_closure obligation MC-01..MC-13 MUST equal READBACK_CLOSED
global_closure_rule.handoff_ready_rule: handoff_ready_for_profile_update = true only when every mandatory closure MC-01..MC-13 is READBACK_CLOSED, MC-13 full step-by-step replay is clean with zero open observations, all required negative tests reject, all positive tests pass, and the exact revision is bound to readback evidence.

mandatory_closures.title: Live research execution capability
mandatory_closures.issue: The method can require live authority traversal while a runtime producer may have no tool/function-calling capability.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: For every run requiring live investigation, prove one executable research path: TOOL_CAPABLE_PRODUCER or EXTERNAL_AUTHORITY_RESOLVER. A no-tool producer may run only when the external resolver has already materialized the complete bounded evidence/query manifest needed for the run and can hydrate remaining refs JIT without model-authored authority.
close_evidence: exact caller/runtime identity
declared research_execution_mode
successful live lookup/readback through that mode
negative test: live-research case with neither capability is rejected before production
forbidden_shortcuts: Treat prompt instructions as tool capability
Assume a local model can query GitHub/Supabase because the method says to do so

mandatory_closures.title: Canonical model context pack
mandatory_closures.issue: The files delivered to the producer must not depend on an ad-hoc caller or null model_context.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Compile a canonical minimal context manifest from runtime binding: required sources, optional allowed sources, section projection, exact source SHA/digest, byte/token budget and excluded payloads. Persist/read back the manifest actually delivered.
close_evidence: non-null canonical model_context contract
actual delivered context manifest bound to execution and source revision
budget guard positive and overflow negative tests

mandatory_closures.title: Evidence manifest end-to-end transport
mandatory_closures.issue: Candidate validation can depend on an evidence manifest that the runtime caller does not pass through all gates.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Transport the same digest-bound evidence manifest from resolver to deterministic validator, semantic utility, independent semantic judge and canonical quality receipt. Each consumer must record the exact manifest digest it consumed.
close_evidence: one integration run showing identical evidence_manifest_sha256 at every hop
negative test: omit or mutate manifest at any hop and fail closed

mandatory_closures.title: Exact evidence resolution including EKB and zero-row results
mandatory_closures.issue: Generic references or zero-row EKB lookups can appear as evidence; material claims may also be uncited.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Every material evidence_ref must resolve to one manifest item with exact locator, query/result status, observed_at/currentness and subject. EMPTY/NOT_FOUND may prove absence only when the query scope is exact; it may not support a positive existence claim. Every material factual claim must cite at least one resolving evidence item.
close_evidence: generic unresolved EKB ref fixture is rejected
zero-row positive-claim fixture is rejected
true-but-uncited material claim fixture is rejected
exact absence query may support an absence claim

mandatory_closures.title: Complete research query trace
mandatory_closures.issue: The producer/resolver's intermediate authority lookups were not recorded, preventing step-by-step reconstruction.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Record every authority/evidence lookup executed by the tool-capable producer or external resolver. Each query trace item binds actor, execution_id, surface, exact locator or canonicalized query fingerprint, input digest, result status/count, result digest, observed_at and emitted evidence IDs. Sensitive values may be redacted from payload text but not from digests/lineage.
close_evidence: integration test reconstructs all evidence IDs from query_trace
negative test: evidence item without producing query/read is rejected when live lookup was required

mandatory_closures.title: Pre-freeze schema and typed protocol validation
mandatory_closures.issue: A candidate with malformed test_protocol setup/action reached downstream validation.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Before candidate digest/freeze, validate the complete candidate against the exact current schema and reject malformed typed collections. Freeze is impossible when schema validation has any error.
close_evidence: malformed setup/action fixture rejected before freeze
valid candidate frozen only after zero schema errors
candidate receipt records schema revision and validation digest

mandatory_closures.title: Single ownership of structural rules
mandatory_closures.issue: Structural rules were duplicated between runtime_validate.py and runtime_semantic_utility.py and could drift silently.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Every structural blocking rule/code has one canonical owner. runtime_validate owns structural rules; semantic utility may consume the deterministic gate and run distinct utility-only checks but may not reimplement or re-emit structural rule logic. Maintain a machine-readable rule ownership catalog.
close_evidence: static ownership test finds zero duplicate structural rule IDs/codes
mutation of one structural rule has one implementation target and all dependent tests detect the change
utility result cannot emit a structural-owned blocking code

mandatory_closures.title: Canonical finding deduplication
mandatory_closures.issue: The same underlying defect can be counted separately by schema and validator layers.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Aggregate findings by a canonical fingerprint built from rule_id + candidate_path/subject + failure_class. Preserve all detector/source layers as evidence, but count one logical finding once. Different failure classes at the same path remain distinct.
close_evidence: setup/action malformed fixture yields one logical finding per malformed field, not duplicate schema+validator findings
distinct defects on same field remain distinct
reported finding_count equals canonical unique finding IDs

mandatory_closures.title: Enforced reviewer independence
mandatory_closures.issue: A comparator/reviewer can share producer execution identity and independence may be merely asserted.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Canonical semantic acceptance requires reviewer_execution_id != producer_execution_id, reviewer actor/session context isolated from producer private reasoning, exact candidate frozen before review, and reviewer inputs limited to the authorized scope packet, exact candidate, evidence bundle and current authority needed to verify them.
close_evidence: quality receipt binds distinct producer and reviewer execution IDs
same-execution fixture is rejected
candidate mutation after review freeze invalidates receipt

mandatory_closures.title: Observed semantic judge invocation and canonical quality receipt
mandatory_closures.issue: Judge files/materializers may exist without an actual caller executing them.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Resolve and prove the physical caller path candidate -> deterministic gate -> utility floor -> independent semantic judge -> semantic result validator -> quality receipt materializer -> quality receipt validator. Component registration or runtime_binding labels alone do not close this obligation.
close_evidence: integration trace proves every hop consumed the exact candidate/evidence/scope digests
missing judge invocation blocks receipt
utility PASS without semantic result cannot be represented as accepted quality

mandatory_closures.title: Physical next-gate, terminality and readback closure
mandatory_closures.issue: A next_gate label can exist without an operational consumer; side-channel failure can leave canonical execution non-terminal.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: For every material edge, independently prove producer -> transported contract -> real consumer -> authority/enforcement -> effect/readback. A next_gate must resolve to an actual consumer. When an auxiliary queue/worker and canonical execution represent the same execution, terminal success/failure/cancelled state must reconcile to the canonical execution or an explicit authority contract must prove why it is non-authoritative.
close_evidence: next_gate consumer positive test
no-consumer fixture fails
queue/worker terminal failure propagates or explicitly reconciles to canonical execution in test/readback
rollback/readback tested when applicable

mandatory_closures.title: Selected-repair change completeness
mandatory_closures.issue: A proposed repair edge/change can appear in the material graph or implementation package without being declared in implementation_delta/deliverables.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: Independently enumerate every selected-repair material change from the entire candidate and reconcile 100% against implementation_delta + deliverables + wiring. Any graph proposed_change_ref or required mechanism absent from the declared footprint blocks producer decision closure before handoff_ready can be true.
close_evidence: undeclared queue-terminal bridge style fixture rejected before handoff_ready
all selected-repair change refs map to declared target/action/dependency/acceptance evidence
discovery-only out-of-scope findings remain outside selected repair

mandatory_closures.title: Full step-by-step closure replay
mandatory_closures.issue: A grouped or summary validation can hide defects that become visible only when producer investigation, transport, each deterministic check, every judge input and repeated controls are traced individually.
mandatory_closures.required_behavior: After MC-01..MC-12 are implemented, replay the same step-by-step methodology used by the 247-step SRCR V0.5 Lifecycle trace on the current exact revision and current exact candidate. Do not group checks. Trace every producer investigation item and live lookup, every transport hop, every deterministic/schema/subvalidator check separately, every required judge input and invocation, and every rule-ownership/deduplication check. Verify every cited live evidence reference against current authority. The replay may contain more than 247 rows when the current version adds material steps, but it may not omit any baseline category or collapse multiple controls into one row.
implementation_targets: semantic judge and quality receipt trace
close_evidence: exact profile/source revision, candidate digest, evidence-manifest digest and scope digest frozen before replay
one row per individual step with input received, output produced, expected output, input completeness, output correctness, evidence refs and note
100% of live evidence references independently resolve or are exact evidence-bound absence results
0 incomplete required inputs
0 unexpected/incorrect outputs
0 unresolved or fabricated evidence references
0 missing transport hops
0 missing semantic-judge/quality-receipt invocations when applicable
0 duplicated structural-rule ownership
0 duplicated logical findings after canonical deduplication
0 open material observations or blockers
all NOT_APPLICABLE rows carry an explicit evidence/rationale and are not used to hide an applicable check
mandatory_closures.acceptance_rule: CLOSED only when the complete ungrouped replay returns zero open observations, zero failed applicable steps and zero unresolved mandatory inputs. Any observation reopens the owning MC obligation(s) and MC-13 remains open until repaired and replayed clean.

required_for_close: 100% live research lookups traceable when live research applies
same candidate/evidence/scope digests across semantic result and quality receipt
no merge/runtime activation/production mutation is implied by this specification
MC-13 complete ungrouped replay: 0 open observations, 0 failed applicable steps, 0 unresolved mandatory inputs
